findings.title: Pointer capture collapses a completed inside drag to a single cell
findings.evidence: Unchanged public Runtime/Harness probe inside_drag_preserves_full_selected_range passes on6841 and fails on177. Drag(1,1)->(5,1) previously leaves normalized selection(1,1,1,5); now leaves(1,5,1,5). New capture changes delivery to runtime.rs pointer_captured: mouse up queuesRelease,DragEnd,Click while inside captured bounds. TerminalView clears selecting onRelease/DragEnd, then treats trailingClick as anotherPress and overwrites anchor and selection at release cell. This is not the pre-existing selectingtrue problem and not an incoming262Viewport failure.
findings.repair: Keep capture, real typing and cursor ownership. Make selection start/drag/finish handling distinguish trailing click from a new press; do not reset the completed drag selection onClick. Add an unchanged before/after regression asserting selected text/range, capture and selecting lifecycle for inside/outside release and subsequent move. Fix at TerminalView or a demonstrated shared pointer contract, not Jackin.
